nodes.name: Every 30 Minutes
nodes.notes: Poll cadence, not send cadence. The daily cap in the API is what limits mail volume.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.value: =StandardStatus eq 'Active' and ModificationTimestamp gt {{ $now.minus(35, 'minutes').toISO() }} and (PropertySubType eq 'SingleFamilyResidence' or PropertyType eq 'ResidentialIncome')

nodes.name: Fetch Modified Listings
nodes.notes: RESO Web API. The 35-minute lookback deliberately overlaps the 30-minute schedule — duplicates are cheap (listing_key is a primary key), missed listings are not.

nodes.name: DealMachine Enrichment
nodes.notes: Continues on error: missing enrichment costs confidence points, it does not drop the listing. Map their response into { ownership, arv } in the next node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ listing: $('One At A Time').item.json, arv: $('DealMachine Enrichment').item.json.arv, ownership: $('DealMachine Enrichment').item.json.ownership, sentToday: $json.sent_today }) }}

nodes.name: Log Prediction
nodes.notes: EVERY evaluation, including REJECTs. This table is the entire feedback loop — a prediction you didn't log can never be calibrated.

nodes.name: Open Negotiation Thread
nodes.notes: stage OPENED, opening_offer = current_offer = offer.offerPrice, economics frozen from the evaluation.

nodes.name: Queue For Review
nodes.notes: Held, not discarded. Work this queue — REVIEW is where the deals a human would take often live.
